title: Exterior sheaves commute with open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $n\geq0$, and $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme. For the exterior sheaf defined by sheafification of sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules $(\bigwedge^n\mathcal M)|_U\cong\bigwedge^n(\mathcal M|_U)$. No local-freeness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Obtain the mutually inverse morphisms of [lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-restrict-hom-data] for the upstream exteriorPower construction. Package their two inverse equations as the hom_inv_id and inv_hom_id fields of a categorical isomorphism. The legacy consumers use the proved exteriorSheaf_eq_exteriorPower comparison to rewrite this theorem at M and M.restrict U.ι; the duplicate Sheaf module and its two private equality helpers are retired.

proof_origin.note: Retire the duplicate under coord/retire-items.tsv and the human hand-off. Attach the already-proved upstream theorem; every direct consumer rewrites its result through the existing proved exterior-sheaf equality. No new proof obligation or unit-route change.
